name: scene3d_get_actor_motion
description: Read one actor performance in one Motion take. Returns full prompts/routes, durable generation status, and the etag required by generate/remove. A ready status proves playable full-take data, not that its route or acting fits current scene geometry; compare them during blocking/continuity improvements and replace mismatched performance. Always re-read after a conflict. @see guides_get('scene3d')

shotId.description: Exact take id from scene3d_state cameraPath.
